name: Public challenge
summary: A friend's public 30-day challenge as a flame wall: join, check in each day, keep your streak and hype the crew.
useWhen: a post starting a daily challenge others can join: gym, running, no phone after 11
dontUseWhen: a private streak in a group chat (use gym)
anything scored head to head (use challenge-friend)

params.others: people outside your friends who joined
